notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed; no hardware was attached or run. The package drives the Go1 environment UnrealMujoco-Go1-v0; the sibling registered ids UnrealMujoco-G1-v0 and UnrealMujoco-MicroDuck-v0 (gym_unrealcv/__init__.py:10-19) are named in facts.md but not implemented. The upstream environment needs gym 0.10.9, unrealcv 1.3.2 and a running packaged Unreal Engine process, so the fake backend is the package's own pure Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py); the sim backend (gym.make with the upstream package and an UnrealCV server) was not run and the fake was never compared with the upstream environment. The fake keeps the real 48-element observation length of Go1 but not the server's observation layout: 12 joint positions, 12 applied action values and 24 zero padding values, all listed in the fidelity gaps (level F0). The real size is 48, so no smaller array is returned. No upstream code was imported or executed. Expected warnings only: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed of the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for the integer inputs the bridge derives (seed in reset and seed class, ticks, and the numeric action.values element). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warnings. Only catalogue classes are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
